children: Amazon Web Services (AWS) announced on Monday that its first cloud infrastructure region in Saudi Arabia is on track to launch in December 2026, supporting more than $5.3 billion (SAR19.88 billion) in planned cloud infrastructure investment in the Kingdom.

Additionally, AWS and Public Investment Fund-owned Humain have expanded their strategic collaboration to make up to 50 megawatts (MW) of capacity available in Saudi Arabia’s first AI Zone by 2028, the company announced at the LEAP technology event in Riyadh.
The AI Zone will include AWS Trainium chips and the latest NVIDIA AI infrastructure to support artificial intelligence training and inference workloads.

The AWS Region, first announced in March 2024, will comprise three Availability Zones at launch, and enable developers, startups and enterprises to run applications and serve end users from data centres located within the Kingdom.
Its launch will increase AWS's global infrastructure footprint to 40 regions worldwide.

title: AWS targets December launch for $5.3bln Saudi cloud region
